QuestInfo.name: Phantom's Hideaway
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce contacted you again. Perhaps she has news of the rest of the heroes. Talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Athena Pierce says no matter how hard she tried, she can't find Phantom. Given his elusiveness, it's not all that surprising so you decided to go after him yourself. Go to Phantom's Secret Storage Room in Orbis, and maybe you'll find him there.
QuestInfo.2: You went to Phantom's Secret Storage Room in Orbis, but he is nowhere to be found. Seeing that the lock was broken off, maybe he was there recently.
